scope: Selected regulated weak mixed heat limit using the actual rough field as smearing and the actual smooth polynomial test; quantitative first omitted coefficient and remaining full-tail capacity. Not a nonlinear action theorem or complete projection.
ordinary_argument_review: The actual half-domain background and the family exp(2s v)g0 for v=-z^4 are smooth up to the outer boundary and regular at the bolt. A smooth double is not asserted.
The exact partner trace identity puts the actual h into a fixed scalar smearing; differentiation in the smooth test retains the second metric vertex.
Positive-time convergence uses W2,infinity approximation. Boundary profile variation starts at jet weight four because v and its first three boundary jets vanish.
Gaussian boundary profiles multiplied by the uniform |h_e|<=H z^3 bound contribute O(t^3); interior coefficients are expanded on the actual smooth half-domain. No fourth derivative of h_e is needed.
The resulting finite constant is qualitative. It establishes the selected regulator limit, not its numerical cap precision or C2 action regularity at a rough base metric.
The a6 coefficient is reduced from the universal bulk formula. Its mixed boundary completion vanishes by jet weight, with all bolt/outer fluxes checked in the ordinary argument.
The actual radial constraint identity moves derivatives off h1. Bernstein ranges and exact log moments bound its local coefficient, retaining the finite-cut endpoint and the remaining interval.
The whole residual after a6 remains unknown. Positive numerical capacity is not a certified heat cap or the full quantum/contact projection.
